import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 12, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#1a202c", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
# Dimensionless Cartesian coordinates; all endpoints are specified by the prompt. origin = np.array([0.0, 0.0]) e1 = np.array([1.0, 0.0]) e2 = np.array([0.0, 1.0]) v = 2 * e1 + 3 * e2
blue = "#2b6cb0" orange = "#dd6b20" ink = "#1a202c" guide = "#94a3b0"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.2, 4.2), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0.09, 0.09, 0.82, 0.86]) ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") ax.set_xlim(-0.65, 2.65) ax.set_ylim(-0.48, 3.65)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(0, 3, 1)) ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 4, 1)) ax.grid(True, color="#e6ebef", linewidth=0.7, zorder=0) ax.tick_params( axis="both", which="both", bottom=False, left=False, labelbottom=False, labelleft=False ) for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False)
# Parallelogram construction. ax.plot([2, 2], [0, 3], color=guide, linewidth=1.1, linestyle=(0, (4, 4)), zorder=1) ax.plot([0, 2], [3, 3], color=guide, linewidth=1.1, linestyle=(0, (4, 4)), zorder=1)
def arrow(endpoint, color, linewidth, dashed=False, zorder=3): patch = FancyArrowPatch( posA=origin, posB=endpoint, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=13 if linewidth < 2.5 else 16, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)) if dashed else "-", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, capstyle="round", joinstyle="round", zorder=zorder, ) ax.add_patch(patch)
# Dashed scaled vectors remain visible beyond the solid unit vectors. arrow(2 * e1, blue, 1.9, dashed=True, zorder=3) arrow(3 * e2, orange, 1.9, dashed=True, zorder=3) arrow(e1, blue, 2.0, zorder=4) arrow(e2, orange, 2.0, zorder=4) arrow(v, ink, 2.8, zorder=5)
ax.text(-0.12, -0.12, r"$O$", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=13) ax.text(0.55, -0.17, r"$\vec{e}_1$", color=blue, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=13) ax.text(1.76, -0.17, r"$2\vec{e}_1$", color=blue, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=13) ax.text(-0.15, 0.53, r"$\vec{e}_2$", color=orange, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=13) ax.text(-0.15, 2.16, r"$3\vec{e}_2$", color=orange, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=13) ax.text(1.0, 3.33, r"$\vec{v}=2\vec{e}_1+3\vec{e}_2$", color=ink, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14)
